preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each array length is between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in as_)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array is between 1 and the length of the array.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= n * (n + 1) // 2 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each count is between 0 and the maximum possible number of subarrays.
